description: Rambler Bangla v31.3.0 — Unified 60-patch Morphe suite for Gboard 18.5.4 with live AMOLED Dark Keyboard toggle (default OFF so stock Material You dark gray contrast stays normal), persistent Clipboard Drag-to-Reorder (tap & hold + drag within Pinned/Recent while preserving stationary long-press Pin/Delete menu and swipe-to-delete), true native suggestion-strip @Mention integration, unconditional Rambler+ activation, phonetic Bangla voice engine, Rambler Extras, and Gboard Patches.
